description: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and an unspecified metric across four different categories: Tutorials, Library Documentation, Github files, and an unspecified metric represented on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens," has a linear scale, ranges from 200 to 900, and is marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, ranges from 10 to 40, and is marked at intervals of 10. The plot includes four lines: the blue line representing Tutorials starts at around 23 at 200 tokens and increases to approximately 30 at 800 tokens; the red line representing Library Documentation begins at about 25 at 200 tokens, rises to roughly 32 at 800 tokens, and then slightly decreases to around 29 at 900 tokens; the green line representing Github files starts at approximately 29 at 200 tokens, peaks at around 32 at 800 tokens, and then drops to about 29 at 900 tokens; the yellow line representing an unspecified category starts at around 32 at 200 tokens and sharply declines to approximately 11 at 900 tokens. Each line is marked with a corresponding colored circle at data points corresponding to 200, 400, 600, 800, and 900 tokens on the x-axis.
